## Appearance

Anne Shirley has a little pointed chin, a white face, and big, gray eyes. Her unbraided hair, which was once dyed green, can be seen streaming behind her in a torrent of brightness.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P1](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P32](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P24](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0024)_

## Personality

Anne Shirley is an imaginative and talkative child who possesses a generous nature, though she can also be careless and reckless at times. She displays an optimistic mindset, noting that bad things rarely turn out as poorly as expected. Driven by a desire to be good-looking when she grows up and to be called Cordelia, her primary wishes include staying at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and eventually becoming a teacher like Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). Additionally, she demonstrates a motivation to confess her mistakes and take responsibility for her actions, such as when she resolved to confess a fault in order to attend a picnic.

## History

After being taken to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by mistake instead of a boy, Anne Shirley breaks down in tears, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) ultimately decide to keep and raise her. [Anne](../character/anne.md) quickly makes a lifelong friend in [Diana Barry](../character/di.md), though their friendship is briefly severed when [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally serves [Diana](../character/diana.md) wine; [Anne](../character/anne.md) later redeems herself and earns the Barrys' gratitude by saving Diana's sick sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md). Her early years at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) are marked by mishaps—including accidentally dyeing her hair green, which forces [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to cut it off—and a fierce academic rivalry with classmate [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), whose offer of friendship she initially spurns. When [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to enter the advanced class to train as a teacher, she prepares for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination under the mentorship of Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). After completing her studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), [Anne](../character/anne.md) selflessly chooses to forego her college scholarship and stay at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to care for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), whose sight is failing. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) yields his teaching position in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so [Anne](../character/anne.md) can take it, prompting her to forgive him and rekindle their friendship. As the new schoolteacher, [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in forming the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) to beautify the town, navigating local setbacks and accidentally selling her neighbor's cow along the way. Despite minor misadventures, such as accidentally staining her nose with rug dye before hosting a famous author, [Anne](../character/anne.md) establishes herself as a central figure in the community and helps reconcile her neighbor, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), with his estranged wife.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. ## Quotes

> "I’ll fold them nicely tonight. They always made us do that at the asylum. Half the time, though, I’d forget, I’d be in such a hurry to get into bed nice and quiet and imagine things."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P2](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0002)

> "I’d do anything to oblige you. But you’ll have to tell me what to say for this once. After I get into bed I’ll imagine out a real nice prayer to say always. I believe that it will be quite interesting, now that I come to think of it."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P15](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0015)

> "But I’d be ever so much gratefuller if—if you’d made just one of them with puffed sleeves. Puffed sleeves are so fashionable now. It would give me such a thrill, Marilla, just to wear a dress with puffed sleeves."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P9](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0009)

> "Oh, Marilla, I’m frightened—now that it has come I’m actually frightened. What if she shouldn’t like me! It would be the most tragical disappointment of my life."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P10](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0010)

> "I’ll just eat one tonight, Marilla. And I can give Diana half of them, can’t I? The other half will taste twice as sweet to me if I give some to her. It’s delightful to think I have something to give her."
>
> — Anne Shirley — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P45](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0045)

## Relationships

### [Di](../character/di.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--di.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Di](../character/di.md) hit it off early in their childhood, swearing a solemn vow to be best friends forever. They spend their time together enjoying social gatherings, participating in community ventures like collecting subscriptions for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), and helping each other out in times of trouble. Their bond remains close and steady over the years, marked by deep affection and shared adventures.

- Friend of — close friends and chums  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. ### [Diana](../character/diana.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/di.md) is Anne's primary confidante and best friend. Their bond faced an early strain when Diana's mother forbade them from seeing each other after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served [Diana](../character/diana.md) wine, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) fully restored the relationship by saving Diana's young sister from croup. From attending school and parties together to coming to each other's rescue during household mishaps, they maintain a deeply affectionate and supportive friendship.

- Friend of — best chums and schoolmates  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

[Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) was initially the target of Anne's fierce, unilateral hatred and resentment after an early school incident. Despite his repeated attempts to apologize and make peace—including saving her from a sinking boat—[Anne](../character/anne.md) held a grudge for years while they maintained a sharp, silent academic rivalry at school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). By the time they both begin working in community endeavors like the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), their hostility cools into mutual respect and collaboration.
